question: Let $A$ and $B$ be $2 \times 2$ matrices such that $AB = BA$. If $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix}$, find $d$ in terms of $a$.
explanation:
Calculating $AB$ and $BA$:

$AB = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} a & b+2d \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix}$

$BA = \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} a & 2a + b \\ 0 & d \end{pmatrix}$

Equate $b+2d = 2a + b \implies d = a$.
